name: qompack
description: Qompack keeps a local record of the session and restores the important parts after Claude Code compacts its context, with tools to recall anything left out. Each entry is one release target; install exactly one, the entry for your OS and CPU.

plugins.name: qompack-linux-amd64
plugins.description: Qompack for Linux on x86-64 (linux/amd64). Install only the one entry that matches your machine.

plugins.description: Qompack for Linux on ARM64 (linux/arm64). Install only the one entry that matches your machine.
